points.quote: A document is a Yjs CRDT (`Y.Doc`). BlockSuite models blocks as Y.Maps and Y.Arrays inside it (`blocksuite/framework/store`). The workspace has a root doc that holds metadata, and each page is its own sub-doc.
An edit mutates the Y.Doc in the editor. ... For any other origin it calls `applyUpdate(doc, bin, NBSTORE_ORIGIN)` on the live Y.Doc, and the editor re-renders from that.
Storage and sync treat a doc as binary Yjs update blobs, not as structured rows.
Blobs and awareness use parallel storages, and blobs also have their own IndexedDB or SQLite stores.
**Web:** IndexedDB (`impls/idb`). ... **Desktop and mobile:** a native SQLite database (`impls/sqlite`, `SqliteDocStorage` plus `SqliteDocSyncStorage`).
A remote update goes into local storage first. ... For cloud workspaces, `impls/cloud/doc.ts` talks to the NestJS server over socket.io. ... Local-only workspaces have no remote peer.
